chunks: To God belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth, and His the power over everything.

key_terms.قَدِيرٌ: Almighty / Powerful / Capable of all things

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's ownership of the heavens and the earth?
ai.summary: This verse, situated in Surah Al-Ma'idah, underscores Allah's absolute sovereignty (Mulk) over the cosmos, a theme particularly resonant in Shia theology regarding the divine authority that underpins both creation and the Imamate. It affirms His omnipotence, serving as a foundational reminder of His capacity to enact judgment and bestow grace, thereby linking cosmic power with spiritual guidance.
